known.via: English Wikipedia "Montagne de Reims" (a wine place on Wikidata)

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: One of the five Champagne sub-regions, around Reims Mountain between Reims and Épernay, with nine Grand Cru villages. Its soils are chalk-based and Pinot Noir is the main grape.
